===Psychoactive substances===
Compounds within our [[psychoactive substance index]] in no specific order which may cause this effect include:

* [[Methamphetamine]]
* [[Alcohol]]
* [[GBL]]
* [[MDMA]]
* [[MDA]]
* [[ΑMT|AMT]]
* [[AET]]
* [[PCP]]
* [[Dextromethorphan|DXM]]
* [[Methadone]]
* [[Nitrous]]
* [[Cocaine]]
* [[Haloperidol]]
* [[Synthetic cannabinoid|Synthetic Cannabinoids]]
